We consider Knowledge Graph-to-Text (KG-to-Text) generation where the task consists of verbalising the content of a KG...

answer_4.guideline: The annotators are then asked to answer the following four questions about the three texts: • Please, select the text which is the closest to the data shown. Consider both additions and omissions. • Please, select the text which is the farthest from the data shown. Consider both additions and omissions. • Please, select the text which is the most fluent. • Please, select the text which is the least fluent.
